items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: So I went around to the Paramount and got in touch with Whiteman and he said, 'Okay, we go up to Boston and so be there and go up with us,'

ctx.x: Now, I think that Doc deserves a lot of the credit for doing that. He told me that he was afraid that they wouldn't get anything done on the date. I think it was down

in Camden that that was made.
Anyway, it turned out fine. Bix played one of his best choruses, and the saxophone chorus was terrific. So I went around to the Paramount and got in touch with Whiteman and he said, 'Okay, we go up to Boston and so be there and go up with us,' so he said, 'Don't worry about doing any arrangements; just get acquainted with the guys in the band and what we do.'
So I joined the band and went out on the road with them. Went to Boston and I think Charlie Margulis joined us soon and Jimmy and Tommy were there, Charlie and let's see --
